title: Clinical and Pathologic Studies in Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma and Hodgkin's Disease
official: Clinical and Pathologic Studies in Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma and Hodgkin's Disease
summary: The purpose of this study is to characterize the molecular and cell biology of the tumor cells in lymphoma.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Hodgkin's disease or non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, any cellular classification, any stage, any grade.
* Adult or pediatric patients receiving lymph node excision for purposes other than cancer therapy (i.e. tonsillectomy, sleep apnea).
* A routine procedure for tissue collection is planned.
* Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without NHL or Hodgkin's disease
